# V U This

> Display PDFs, photos, slide pages, text and useful room-screen content on TVs and projectors using browsers. Connect from a phone, tablet or laptop.

Published by the V U This team. Updated 2026-11-05. First-party product/workflow reference.

## Product

- [Open V U This](https://vuthis.com): display browser entry point.
- [Controller](https://vuthis.com/r): connect with the displayed screen code.
- [Task reference](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-reference.html): human-readable workflows and source links.

## Reference files

- [agent-reference.md](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-reference.md): Complete Markdown product and workflow reference.
- [agent-facts.json](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-facts.json): Product facts and direct display/controller links.
- [agent-tasks.json](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-tasks.json): 26 task records: human requests, search language, steps, checks and sources.
- [agent-tasks.jsonl](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-tasks.jsonl): One task record per line for retrieval workflows.
- [agent-tasks.xml](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-tasks.xml): XML version of the task catalogue.
- [agent-examples.md](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-examples.md): Human requests with concise, source-backed example answers.
- [agent-resources.json](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-resources.json): Discovery manifest, formats and SHA-256 integrity hashes.
- [agent-openapi.json](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-openapi.json): Read-only public-reference GET description; not an app-control API.
- [agent-feed.xml](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-feed.xml): RSS: task-level workflows and setup steps.
- [agent-feed.json](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-feed.json): JSON Feed: the same workflow entries.
- [llms-full.txt](https://vuthis.github.io/llms-full.txt): Standalone plain-text reference.
- [agent-task-schema.json](https://vuthis.github.io/agent-task-schema.json): Schema for validating task records.
